citations.claim: approach N is green at first violating step while emergency active
approach E was yellow at prior step, showing preemption cut yellow/all-red

counterfactual.change: moved emergency approach N->E at same t/duration so no direction switch is needed; failure disappears

explanation: Emergency for N starting at t=147 while controller was in EW green (step146) / EW yellow (step147) forced immediate NS green at step148 with 0s all-red (need 1s) and truncated EW yellow to 1s (need 6s). Preemption path skips yellow completion and all-red clearance.

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 1 s)

vision_note: At step 147 the east-west approaches show yellow while north-south remain red. At step 148 north-south instantly show green with no intervening all-red interval, cutting the yellow to a single second.
